from build123d import *

# ----- dimensions (mm) -----
overall_len = 79.9          # total length (drawing)
tip_len     = 12.0          # length of the pointed tip
blade_h     = 8.0           # blade height (front view)
blade_t     = 2.5           # blade thickness
guard_len   = 7.0           # cross-guard length along axis
guard_h     = 11.7          # cross-guard height (end view)
guard_t     = 4.5           # cross-guard width  (end view)
grip_len    = 20.0          # grip length ("20" dimension)
grip_h      = 5.0           # grip height
grip_t      = 2.5           # grip thickness
fillet_r    = 0.9           # R0.9 on the cross-guard
slot_w      = 1.6           # fork slot width
slot_depth  = 14.0          # fork slot depth from the end

blade_len = overall_len - guard_len - grip_len   # length of blade body

# ----- pointed blade (profile in XZ, extruded in Y) -----
pts = [(0.0, 0.0),
       (tip_len, blade_h / 2.0),
       (blade_len, blade_h / 2.0),
       (blade_len, -blade_h / 2.0),
       (tip_len, -blade_h / 2.0)]
blade_profile = make_face(Plane.XZ * Polyline(*pts, close=True))
blade = extrude(blade_profile, amount=blade_t / 2.0, both=True)

# ----- cross-guard with R0.9 fillets on its axial edges -----
guard = Box(guard_len, guard_t, guard_h)
guard = fillet(guard.edges().filter_by(Axis.X), fillet_r)
guard = Pos(blade_len + guard_len / 2.0, 0, 0) * guard

# ----- grip -----
grip = Pos(blade_len + guard_len + grip_len / 2.0, 0, 0) * Box(grip_len, grip_t, grip_h)

part = blade + guard + grip

# ----- fork slot at the free end of the grip -----
slot = Pos(overall_len - slot_depth / 2.0, 0, 0) * Box(slot_depth, grip_t * 3.0, slot_w)
part = part - slot

part.name = "pegasus_pin"
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---- Overall envelope -------------------------------------------------
plate_size   = 80.0          # square outer envelope
plate_thk    = 4.2           # constant material thickness (Z)

# ---- Frame -------------------------------------------------------------
frame_width  = 4.2           # wall thickness of the square frame
inner_size   = plate_size - 2 * frame_width      # 71.6 inner opening

# ---- Ribs ----------------------------------------------------------------
rib_width    = 4.2           # width of each of the two vertical ribs
rib_len      = inner_size    # ribs span the full inner opening
rib_center_x = 21.9          # distance from part centre to rib centre

# ---- Pockets -------------------------------------------------------------
pocket_len   = 36.2          # X length of each pocket
pocket_wid   = 20.2          # Y width of each pocket
pocket_y     = 21.6          # centres of the two outer pockets
mid_y        = 0.0           # centre of the middle pocket

# ---- Build ---------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        # solid plate
        Rectangle(plate_size, plate_size)

        # inner frame opening (leaves a 4.2 wide frame all around)
        Rectangle(inner_size, inner_size, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # two ribs: left and right of centre, each 4.2 wide
        for sx in (-1, 1):
            with Locations((sx * rib_center_x, 0.0)):
                Rectangle(rib_width, rib_len, mode=Mode.ADD)

        # three pockets, one centred on each horizontal strip
        for py in (pocket_y, mid_y, -pocket_y):
            with Locations((0.0, py)):
                Rectangle(pocket_len, pocket_wid, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    extrude(amount=plate_thk)

        angle = i * angle_step
        x = r * math.cos(angle)

        coords.append((x, y))
    return coords

# Dimensions taken from the target drawing (image 1)
thickness      = 4.6          # side view
total_height   = 62.2         # overall length (boss centre -> arrow tip)
top_width      = 20.7         # arrow-head width
stem_width     = 5.6          # A/F of the narrow stem
base_width     = 10.4         # body width where it meets the boss
boss_dia       = 16.6         # bottom circular boss
boss_radius    = boss_dia / 2
taper_height   = 20.0         # estimated arrow-head height
fillet_r       = 1.5          # 3x R1.5
hole_dia       = 8.0          # double-D through hole
hole_af        = 4.7          # across flats

with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- front profile in XZ plane ---------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        # bottom circular boss centred on origin
        Circle(boss_radius)

        # tapered lever body with arrow-head top
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                (-base_width / 2, 0),
                (-stem_width / 2, total_height - taper_height),
                (-top_width  / 2, total_height),
                ( top_width  / 2, total_height),
                ( stem_width / 2, total_height - taper_height),
                ( base_width / 2, 0),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()

    # extrude symmetrically about the XZ plane -> 4.6 total thickness
    extrude(amount=thickness / 2, both=True)

    top_edges = [e for e in p.edges() if e.center().Z > total_height - 0.1]

        Circle(hole_dia / 2)
